## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/modulepass">ModulePass</a> class - This class is used to implement unstructured interprocedural optimizations and analyses.</p>


<p>ModulePasses may do anything they want to the program.</p>
